title: Swell City / Hatchery (shore effects)
assumptions: Wind from 247 deg (WSW), waves toward 67 deg +-15 deg, periods 2.9, 3.6 and 4.5 s (20 m peak wavelength).

River bed: NOAA BAG surveys where they exist (13.6% of the pack, the channel); unsurveyed water ramps from 0 at the shore to the nearest surveyed depth. Survey datum (Columbia River Datum) NOT reconciled with the pool surface.

Both shores reflect with R = 0.5 (basalt and riprap, a guess). The incoming sea is a plane wave of ratio 1 at the western edge (no wind growth along the river, no current). The 0.9 kt opposing current is not in the solver.

Wind keeps making waves along the river, so the solver's steady loss to the walls is divided out: each cross-section is rescaled to a mean of 1 (running mean over 900 m), keeping only the cross-river pattern (shadows behind headlands, focusing, wall lift). The first 450 m at the western edge fade to 1 (edge effects).
The map is the smoothed envelope. The crossing pyramids themselves come from the reflected group added to the sea (see site-seas.js).
